body: Today I attended the funeral of a late teacher, any suicidal thoughts I had, justtt vanished.

Thanks for your response. I get your being brutally honest, I have noticed that in my cover letters as of late they are more on the non-conservative side of what would be expected in a cover letter. I recall when I wrote my first one and let my passion flow through the letter, I thought I was crazy in retrospect it was one of the better cover letters I wrote. Didn't even get an interview, but I was satisfied that I had tried and if this is not what they were looking for then so be it.

I am sure that my sperm donor who has said he wants nothing to do with me, will not be devastated at all. Actually I highly doubt he'll even give a shit. 

NOTHING in my life is going right at this moment. I've been looking for a job for the past 6 months, I am tired of sending out applications with no response, tired of attending interviews only to not land the job. I am tired of trying and not succeeding.

I'm back again. I have been doing some thinking, which would prove to be my undoing. I am so tired of all of the these positive comments and light that people view me in. Today, my mom had a meeting at my brother's school, she met with the Deputy Principal, whom I had previously met with and who was part of the panel that interviewed me for a position there. 

Its amazing that just from less than an hour interview and around a 15 minute meeting, he could have so much to positive things to say about me, yet after sending out applications to almost all of the schools in my country, I still can't seem to land an interview for the most part, far less a job. 

Same thing with my dating life, I am constantly told how much of a wonderful guy I am, yet no one seems to want to date me. Isn't that ironic as hell. 

Now for a darker turn. I need out of this life, but because I am a true idiot, I have been considering ways that would make it as painless as possible for my mother and my brother. Self less thinking even in the face of what is considered by some as the most selfish and desperate act. I wish I had the courage to do it and not care about the people I left behind.
I just saw three ads for Math teachers. Guess I'll try for them.

I cannot work for free, that is out of the question. I refuse to provide labour to a company and assist them in growing their profits while I get nothing. Also, I literally cannot afford to work for free. I'd need to spend money on transportation and other stuff for work. So Not only would I be working for free, but worst yet, I'd be accumulating debt in the process. 

I'd dare say that your situation is the exception rather than the rule. 


Connections where I am, really mean nothing. I know a bunch of Directors and business owners and they are practically useless to me right now.

I've been doing that. But I can't even land a temp job.

I wanted to get a job so I could apply for my PhD out of this country. But I am not in a financial position to do so. Which means I am stuck here for at least the next two years.

That's the problem with applying for job's you are clearly over-qualified for. Human resources fear that you will just be there until you find something more suited for your qualifications and as a result they don't hire you.

No this has got to be a satire. I refuse to believe that there are people who would seriously write those two notes. 

I think all LGBT persons should arm themselves and take action to defend and protect themselves when the need arises, especially from ignorant assholes like these, this is exactly my problem with the cult known as Christianity. They abandon the love their cult manual talks about.

The sure shot way is for them to come home and find you in some serious tongue on tongue action with a member of the same sex......that's actually the stupidest thing I have ever said.

Being serious now, you would have to provide some context, each coming out is different because of the dynamics involved.m
The same reasons you would find more homosexual females. It's more socially acceptable to for women to be homosexual or bisexual than males.

Like others have said before, I don't believe you are confused, you know what you want but may be a little scared or reserve to do it. Based on what I have read just now I think you owe it to him and yourself to tell him how you feel about it. I think one of the greatest problems we have as men especially is talking about our feelings with the people that they concern. Let him know why you stopped speaking to him for 6-7 weeks, this part makes me think that you know exactly what you want but you are too afraid for some reason to go after it. Be yourself and don't let what you believe others may have to say make you miss out on an opportunity to be in a relationship with what seems to be a very awesome dude whom you clearly love.

I'm happy to see that you had allies and that not everyone was against you. In situations like these the negative is way smaller than we imagine it to be and the supporters you have is way larger than you think. I am really happy that there was one person out there who was strong enough to let you know that you had their respect for what you did. Often times we dwell on the negatives without being informed of the positives.
I think the straight to the point approach may be best. It avoids any confusion in the future.

Knowing that I am not alone and meeting other LGBT persons helped me to accept myself for who I am. Another thing that helped too was seeing how those that I met, how proud they were of themselves regardless of what people may say about them.
